candidates.name: safe-subprocess-fixtures
candidates.description: Reusable cross-platform stub-process fixtures and assertions for bounded output, timeout, cancellation, descendant cleanup, and redacted diagnostics.
candidates.reason: Process safety is fragile and the same child-process setup and cleanup evidence is required by discovery, verification, execution, composition, and regression tests; no existing project skill provides these Switchyard-specific fixtures.

candidates.name: adapter-conformance
candidates.description: Repeatable procedure and fixtures for implementing, registering, normalizing, and validating a Switchyard harness adapter without matcher changes.
candidates.reason: Built-in and future adapters repeat a strict vendor-boundary and conformance process across discovery, verification, and execution; existing generic skills do not encode the project contract or policy constraints.

candidates.name: versioned-cli-contracts
candidates.description: Procedure for evolving Switchyard human and JSON command results with stable schemas, exit categories, no-color parity, and redaction checks.
candidates.reason: Multiple commands expose script-facing JSON and human diagnostics under compatibility, accessibility, and privacy constraints, making contract evolution a repeated and failure-prone project-specific process.
